UserWorkspaceProfile.title: UserWorkspaceProfile
UserWorkspaceProfile.description: Private workspace owner anchor document for Master Gate relational verification. Stores display name without exposing PII to other users.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the cloud account menu.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace profile was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace profile was last updated.

FurnitureProjectDoc.title: FurnitureProjectDoc
FurnitureProjectDoc.description: Cloud-persisted 3D carpentry project including parts, fasteners, room layout, and parametric cabinet configs stored as native Firestore maps and lists.

id.description: Unique project identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner (immutable).

parts.description: List of 3D furniture part maps (max 400 parts).

fasteners.description: List of carpentry fastener maps (max 2000 fasteners).

room.description: Optional room geometry, openings, obstacles, and finishes map (or null).

cabinetConfigs.description: Optional map of parametric cabinet group IDs to ParametricCabinetConfig maps (or null).

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client-side epoch millisecond timestamp for local/cloud sync ordering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when project was last updated.

FurnitureTemplateDoc.title: FurnitureTemplateDoc
FurnitureTemplateDoc.description: Cloud-stored starter or user-saved reusable 3D furniture/DIY project template fetched directly from Firestore.

id.description: Unique template identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the template owner (immutable).

project.description: Native Firestore map containing template project name, parts list, fasteners list, optional room and cabinetConfigs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when template was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when template was last updated.

WorkspaceSettingsDoc.title: WorkspaceSettingsDoc
WorkspaceSettingsDoc.description: User-owned warehouse materials catalog, price overrides, and commercial quote settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the settings owner (immutable).

materialsConfig.description: Custom materials list (max 100) and built-in material price/dimension overrides.

quoteSettings.description: Commercial carpentry quote rates (cutting, banding, hardware, margin, VAT).

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client-side epoch millisecond timestamp for local/cloud sync ordering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private workspace anchor document per authenticated Google user.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Private 3D furniture projects belonging to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/templates/{templateId}.description: Starter and custom 3D furniture/DIY project templates stored and fetched from Firestore.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Private workspace settings document (settingId = 'workspace') storing custom materials, prices, and quote configuration.
